N_change: Source two incomplete entries may be replaced by one family only after integration acceptance. No production/default198/160/132 cardinality changed.

vm_count.grain: one row per winning tenant id x vm id x distinct referenced volume id; no-mount VM retains one null-volume row

volume_count.grain: one row per volume id belonging to each maximal known tenant identity

scope.logicalRegionName: required exact-equality logical-region string applied to every instance API and SQL; no mapping from physical region/tenant/VDC/AZ
scope.relations: global relation fetch; join both endpoint IDs only to already region-scoped VM and VOLUME; unresolved selected VM mount retained and marked

identity.tenant: logicalRegionName + exact nonblank tenantId. Nonblank identity bytes are preserved, including leading/trailing whitespace; IDs are never stripped or merged.
identity.resources: id is required and unique per CI; missing schema/duplicate IDs/cross-region rows still block before SQL.
identity.unknown: NULL, empty string, or a string composed entirely of the explicit versioned whitespace codepoint set is unknown. The preflight makes independent schema-projected row copies and canonicalizes only such tenantId values to NULL. The raw pages/rows remain unchanged.
identity.not_whitespace: U+200B zero-width space is deliberately not in this fixed set; a nonblank identity containing it is preserved.
identity.policy: reject blocks if the ranked resource population contains unknown identity. exclude_with_diagnostic excludes exactly the NULL identities present in the validated projection and labels known_tenant_ids_only.

ranking: COUNT(DISTINCT resource id) before detail joins; all equal maxima via MAX comparison, deterministic tenantId/resourceId ordering; no LIMIT1
joins: VM.id=R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId AND relation.volumeId=VOLUME.id. DISTINCT endpoint pair avoids duplicate relation row fanout; mounted volume need not share VM tenant because attachment and ownership are different roles.
NULL_and_empty: No SQL TRIM is used. Every unknown tenantId in the validated projection is NULL; SQL has tenantId IS NOT NULL as its sole tenant exclusion rule. unknown_resource_count is computed from that same projected ranked table. Child mount NULL/no_mount/unresolved_volume semantics are unchanged; no capacity CAST, inferred zero or identity/name substitution.
truthful_empty: Only complete verified totalNum=0 payloads are true empty. Results are zero detail rows under typed schemas. _empty placeholder is blocked, never COUNT1. Missing/error/truncated pages and unknown identities under reject are blocked, not zero.
request_success_receipt: Every page requires ok is True from a trustworthy B fetch-layer receipt, plus no error or success=False. Native raw pages lack status and cannot alone establish request success; do not fabricate receipts.
paging: First call pageNo=1,pageSize=1000. B must request ALL pages under unchanged exact conditions. preflight requires contiguous ordered complete pages, stable totalNum/pageSize/totalPageNo, expected row count, schema, unique IDs; retries/new snapshots must restart full fetch rather than splice mismatched pages.
long_request: The local gate measures expanded compact UTF8 api_call+sql only: <=4096 bytes may materialize, >4096 returns blocked_transport_budget with measured bytes, boundary, limit and reason; preflight/execute refuse it. No entity truncation or raw question-length rule exists. Static placeholder api_call+sql template bytes and full build-plan metadata bytes are measured separately. Full plan is local metadata with no invented official cap; if B sends it or any outer wrapper, B must measure that exact actual envelope with check_envelope_budget and apply the official boundary. Depth4 remains unresolved and is not inferred from these byte measurements.
preflight_interface: preflight(params,pages) returns ready_for_typed_sql, independent validated schema-only tables, projection_contract=tenant-identity-projection-v2, parameter/projection SHA256 and diagnostics. It never mutates original input. Blocked status is not executable.
B_integration_gates: B MUST load validated projected tables (or use execute entrypoint); raw original-row loading is rejected/unsupported. No B or official implementation was changed here.
Preserve ready/blocked state, unknown_resource_count, ranking_population and complete_mount_details; do not claim complete original answer under unknown exclusion or unresolved mounts.
Typed empty tables and truthful successful complete page receipts remain mandatory; _empty placeholder rows are unsupported.
Final actual B envelope byte/depth gates remain pending; local api_call+sql measurement is not official boundary approval.
C must accept tenant ID namespace, tied-maxima policy and unknown population policy before original questions are considered complete.
Runtime adoption/evaluation remains unauthorized and unrun.
unsupported_obligations: claiming complete mount details when unresolved_mount_count>0

SQL_assumption: The returned SQL MUST load preflight tables, not original raw API rows. Raw-row execution is unsupported. execute(params,pages) enforces this locally; execute_prepared(params,prepared) rejects missing receipt, parameter or projection hash drift, noncanonical whitespace identities and diagnostic count mismatch. These receipts/digests detect loading drift, not malicious forgery and do not prove actual API completeness beyond verified envelopes.
